canonical.retention: preserve; merge only through a reviewed minimal change set

noncanonical.retention: preserve in a separate worktree/output root; never promote silently

historical.retention: retain read-only for traceability; exclude from current claims

build.lane: generated package, cache, or temporary artifact
build.retention: regenerate from a manifest; do not treat as source evidence

review-required.retention: preserve unchanged until a human assigns a lane
